widgets_values: 极简古典美学，高级排版海报，荷花艺术，质感荷花纹理，白色到粉红色渐变效果，艺术概念风格，视觉清雅且充满东方古典感；画面右下角放主题字：主题字进行字体设计，极细宋体风格 “悦目荷花”，文字进行错位穿插摆放，字体优雅细长，笔画尾部添加花体曲线，在文字间穿插，整体呈现东方诗意，探索非凡自然与微观世界的艺术化表达，画面上方小文案依次放 “2026”“visual concept”“2026”，下方左边文案突出时间数字 “TIME——07.21/07.25”，画面中融入小小字英文 “Elegant lotus flowers”“Oriental Visual Concept”“Lotus Culture New Expression”

A refined art poster in gold-leaf mineral pigment, merging impressionist brushwork, oil paint and 3D rendering into one surface. The ground is a soft gradient of blue-green tones in several steps, matte and hazy, and a butterfly form is only half visible inside the blur, its wings implied by two long arcs rather than drawn. Motion blur and soft bloom carry the whole field, and fine metallic glitter sits inside the brush marks. The palette leans warm blue-green with off-white and a thread of gold, calm and perfumed. On the lower left one line of flowing brush script reads "Don't wait for inspiration" in thin trailing strokes with a tactile, liquid curve, and directly beneath it one very small line of hairline sans reads "2026 jingchen573". Every other area of the image is free of readable text: no watermark, no signature, no caption and no logo appears.
